languageSetup.title: Choose a display language
languageSetup.label: Display language
languageSetup.hint: You can change it later in Settings.

connections.title: Connections
connections.emptyBody: Add a computer to connect to, and choose the proxy it goes through. Proxies are added on the Proxies page; choose Direct when none is needed.
connections.subtitle: Each connection has its own local entrance address; Remote Desktop reaches the computer through it and the proxy.
connections.deleteBody: “{{name}}” will be deleted, together with its saved password and the user name and certificate trust Remote Desktop remembers for it.

form.name: Name
form.addressHint: Computer name or IP address. If the port is not 3389, write address:port, such as pc.example.com:3390.
form.addressChanged: After the computer changes, the password saved for the old address is deleted.
form.usernameHint: Fills in Remote Desktop's sign-in. DOMAIN\user and user@domain both work.
form.remember: Remember the password (in Windows Credential Manager)
form.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password; type one to replace it.
form.passwordHint: Optional: you can enter it when connecting.
form.noRememberHint: Without remembering, you are asked before each connection; the password is used for that connection only and deleted when it ends.
form.savedByMstsc: Remote Desktop itself remembers a password for this connection (“Remember me” at sign-in).
form.savedByApp: A password is saved for this connection.
form.screensMultimon: All monitors (one remote screen per monitor)
form.displayHint: Clipboard, drives, sound and the other settings come from Remote Desktop's defaults (Default.rdp in Documents): change them in Remote Desktop Connection and click Save.

password.title: Connect to “{{name}}”
password.label: Password for {{user}}
password.hint: You can also leave it empty and let Remote Desktop ask for it.

check.title: Check the route to “{{name}}”
check.running: Reaching the remote computer through the proxy…
check.passed: The route works: the Remote Desktop service answered in {{ms}} ms (security protocol {{protocol}}).
check.passedNegotiation: The route works: the Remote Desktop service answered in {{ms}} ms but refused the security protocols offered ({{reason}}). Remote Desktop may still connect.

log.title: Session log: {{name}}
log.empty: This connection has not been used since the app started.

proxies.title: Proxies
proxies.emptyTitle: No proxies of your own yet
proxies.emptyBody: Add a SOCKS5 or HTTP proxy, such as the local port of v2rayN or Clash (often 127.0.0.1:10808 or 7890). VMess, VLESS, Trojan and share links are coming.
proxies.subtitle: Connections can share a proxy, so switching servers is done in one place.
proxies.directHint: No proxy: connect to the remote computer directly
proxies.latencyHint: Fetches the test URL from Settings through this proxy and measures the time.

form.name: Name
form.unsupportedKind: This kind of proxy cannot be edited here yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.closeBehavior: When the main window is closed
settings.closeToTray: Minimize to the tray and keep running
settings.closeHint: While a remote desktop is connected through a proxy, the window always minimizes to the tray so the connection isn't cut.
settings.localPortHint: Each connection listens on this port at its own 127.x.y.z address. Applies to connections started afterwards.
settings.checkFirst: Check the route before starting Remote Desktop
settings.checkFirstHint: Makes sure the remote computer answers through the proxy first, so a broken route is explained at once instead of Remote Desktop waiting.
settings.testUrlHint: Fetched through a proxy when you test it on the Proxies page.
settings.urlInvalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.
settings.logLevelHint: The log file is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\RDP-over-proxy\logs. Host names, IP addresses and user names are masked before they are written.

common.dataLoadFailed: Could not load the connections and proxies: {{message}}

net.refused: The connection was refused. Check the address and port, and that the service is running.
net.unreachable: The network or the computer is unreachable.
net.reset: The other side reset the connection.
net.dns: The computer name couldn't be found.
net.addressInUse: Another program is already using this local address and port.
net.accessDenied: Windows won't let the app use this local port. Hyper-V or WSL may have reserved it; choose another local port in Settings.
net.addressNotAvailable: This address isn't available on this computer.

probe.noAnswer: The connection closed before the remote computer answered.
probe.notRdp: Something answered, but not a Remote Desktop server. Check the port.
probe.truncated: The remote computer's answer was cut short.
probe.malformed: The remote computer's answer isn't valid Remote Desktop data.

tunnel.noAnswer: The connection closed before the remote computer answered.

proxy.auth: The proxy rejected the user name or password.
proxy.unreachable: Couldn't connect to the proxy server. Check that it's running and that its address and port are right.
proxy.targetFailed: The proxy couldn't connect to the remote computer.
proxy.dropped: The proxy closed the connection before the remote computer answered. Usually the proxy, or the server behind it, can't reach the remote computer.
proxy.unsupported: This kind of proxy isn't supported yet.
proxy.inUse: This proxy is still used by: {{profiles}}.

session.ending: The previous session of this connection is still ending. Connect again once it has ended.
session.loopbackDirect: The remote computer is this computer itself. Without a proxy the tunnel would connect to itself.
session.running: This connection is in use. Disconnect it first.

rdp.noAddress: The .rdp file doesn't say which computer to connect to.

store.notFound: It no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
store.builtIn: The direct connection is built in and can't be changed.

secret.unreadable: A saved password can't be decrypted by this Windows user.

credential.failed: Windows Credential Manager refused the change.

gateway.used: Remote Desktop is set to always connect through an RD Gateway ({{server}}), which can't reach this app's tunnel. Turn the RD Gateway off in Remote Desktop Connection: Show Options → Advanced → Settings.

profile.proxyMissing: This connection's proxy no longer exists. Choose another one.

store.unreadable: {{file}} couldn't be read. It was renamed to .corrupt and left out.
store.newerSchema: {{file}} was saved by a newer version of the app and was left out.
store.secretLost: The password in {{file}} can't be decrypted; the file may come from another Windows user or computer. Enter the password again.
store.loopbackMoved: {{file}} got a new loopback address because its old one was missing or used by another connection.
store.readFailed: {{file}} couldn't be opened, perhaps because another program is using it. It was left out and is unchanged.

settings.recovered: The settings file couldn't be read, so the defaults are in use. The old file was kept as settings.json.corrupt.

log.unavailable: The log file couldn't be opened. The log is kept in memory only.

credential.saveFailed: The password for “{{profile}}” couldn't be saved in Windows Credential Manager.
credential.deleteFailed: The saved password for “{{profile}}” couldn't be deleted.

mstsc.forgetFailed: What Remote Desktop remembers about “{{profile}}” couldn't be removed.

session.upstreamOk: The remote computer answered through the route.
session.upstreamFailing: A connection couldn't reach the remote computer: {{error}}
session.tunnelFailed: The tunnel entrance stopped accepting connections: {{error}}
session.unexpectedEvent: Ignored an unexpected event {{event}} during step “{{step}}”.
session.gatewayMaybe: If Remote Desktop can't connect directly, it may switch to an RD Gateway ({{server}}), which can't reach this app's tunnel.
session.gatewayUnknown: Couldn't read the RD Gateway settings: {{error}}
session.hintFailed: Couldn't pre-fill the user name for Remote Desktop: {{error}}

quit.title: Quit RDP over Proxy?
quit.body_one: {{count}} remote desktop is connected through this app. Quitting disconnects it.
quit.body_other: {{count}} remote desktops are connected through this app. Quitting disconnects all of them.

fieldErrors.requiredForPassword: A user name is needed to save a password.
